name: Lyo.Law
tagline: Store contract for US state statutes.
description: `ILawStore` saves jurisdictions and codes and upserts statute nodes by an opaque source key. An unchanged content hash leaves the row alone. A changed hash keeps the previous text. `LawJurisdictionKey.ThrowIfFederal` rejects `US`. Listing belongs in Lyo Query. Persistence is `Lyo.Law.Postgres`.
features: `UpsertNodeBySourceKeyAsync` matches jurisdiction, code, and source key.
Citation lookup is scoped to one code.
